newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes lower as market remains choppy.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes lower as market remains choppy.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed lower in choppy dealings with the U.S. domestic cash rice market now considered in line with futures, traders said.
"The market is locked in on cash and farmers aren't selling," a trader said. "We're just drifting back and forth."
Rice futures volume was estimated at 500 contracts, down from 539 Tuesday, according to the CBOT. Rice options volume was estimated at 50, up from 27 Tuesday.
Rice closed unchanged to four cents per cwt lower, with November unchanged at $9.83.
